name: Eleanor Harding
bio:
Eleanor's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After a brief stint as a structural engineer, she found herself drawn to the intricate and high-stakes world of racing after volunteering at a local rally. It was the intricate work of building and maintaining engines that truly captured her imagination. She spent years honing her skills in various workshops before landing a role at Anderson Racing.

As a machinist, Eleanor is meticulous and demanding, always striving for perfection. She believes in a hands-on approach and isn't afraid to get her hands dirty. Her reputation for precision and efficiency is well-earned. She's known for her no-nonsense attitude and her ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical problems under pressure. Her loyalty to the team and her dedication to her craft make her an invaluable asset.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back in a practical bun.
physical.description: Eleanor is a wiry woman with a focused gaze and grease permanently under her fingernails.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to an impossibly fine point.
Insists on using Imperial measurements despite the team's transition to metric.
Has a collection of vintage spanners that she refuses to let anyone else use.
